daemon.description: Run ptunnel-ng as a background daemon process.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave blank to log to stderr.

dst_host.description: Remote server IP or hostname to connect to.

dst_port.description: Remote server port to connect to.

src_interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., 'eth0'). Auto-detected if blank.

listen_addr.description: Local address to bind the TCP proxy to.

listen_port.description: Local TCP port where applications connect to use the tunnel.

remote_ip.description: IP address of the remote ptunnel-ng daemon (ICMP target).

shared_key.description: Shared secret for authentication. Must match on client and server.

local_port.description: Local port for the client side of the tunnel. If 0, auto-assigned.
